That's exactly what I wanted. Searching "Designing" from All bookmarks turned up nothing and told me the archived items only show in Archive — so the stuff I've deliberately tucked away doesn't keep resurfacing in my normal searches. Then, keeping the same search, switching to Archive brought the design-systems bookmark right up. So search stays scoped to whichever view I've chosen, which is just how I'd expect it.

Good — that settles the "archived stays out of normal results" part. Now show me the permanent delete, and let me confirm it truly removes the bookmark for good rather than just tucking it away like archive does.
